registry_purpose: Machine-readable index of the PARCEL GEOMETRY / CAMA ArcGIS REST layer for each ORA-validated county-parcel-screen target county. Built for cross-skill consumption (ora-flood-zoning-dd Step 1 uses this to pull the parcel polygon for pad/yard flood testing without re-discovering the endpoint). This is a derived, narrower index of references/county-endpoints.md (the human-readable source of truth, which also carries value/sales/delinquency/owner fields, calibration factors, and per-county quirks) — on any conflict, county-endpoints.md wins and this file should be regenerated from it.
companion_registry_do_not_merge: parcel-data-recovery/references/endpoints.md is a SEPARATE, COMPLEMENTARY registry — building-footprint / CAMA-detail / bulk-export endpoints (FEMA USA Structures, county building outlines, Beacon/Schneider, auditor exports) plus match rates and value-basis calibration. Measured 2026-09-06: of its 17 URLs, only 3 appear in county-endpoints.md's 46, and 14 are unique to it. The counties overlap; the endpoints do not. An audit pass (ORA Automation Audit R23-8) read the shared county names as a dual-write pair and came within one step of merging them, which would have deleted those 14. Diff URLs, never county names, before proposing any consolidation.
derived_index_drift_2026-09-06: ⛔⛔ WITHDRAWN 2026-09-07 — THIS ENTIRE NOTE WAS WRONG. DO NOT ACT ON IT. All 7 endpoints it names as absent from county-endpoints.md are in fact ALREADY DOCUMENTED there; back-porting them would add duplicates to the sourcing source of truth. The error: the check compared URL STRINGS, and county-endpoints.md deliberately does not write endpoints as contiguous URLs. It uses at least three human forms a string diff cannot see — (a) split root+relative, e.g. kent_mi as '**REST root:** https://gis.kentcountymi.gov/agisprod/rest/services' plus '**Layer:** ... mirrored at OpenData/Parcel_Related_Layers/MapServer/0' (same for ottawa_mi, richmond_city_va, dallas_ia — 4 of the 7); (b) an ELIDED path, e.g. baltimore_md as 'https://bcgis.baltimorecountymd.gov/.../Property/MapServer/1'; (c) pure prose, e.g. platte_mo as 'Platte_City_MO_Property_view (services2.arcgis.com/ji2hJlB9RmHn0um4) layer 1' and jackson_mo, which documents FeatureServer/2 as THE source and describes layer 1 inline as 'layer 1 = parcel geometry w/ TIFproject/TIFdistrict/CID/TDD'. Verified county-by-county 2026-09-07 by matching HOST + LAYER-PATH FRAGMENT and then reading each section by hand, not by matching URLs. THE STANDING LESSON, now proven five times in two days across R23-6, R23-8 and this note: a text/regex comparison over a human-written document is not a content comparison — it over-reports absence when the document expresses the same fact in another form, and under-reports when a shallow field walk misses nested structure. Read the sections; do not diff the strings. The ONE residual — CLOSED 2026-09-07, Gabriel-directed: baltimore_md's supplemental layer and jackson_mo's layer 1 were documented only via an elided path and inline prose respectively, so they were human-readable but not machine-extractable. Explicit absolute URL lines have now been added for both in county-endpoints.md, each labelled with why it was added, its layer id/name/type/geometry, its VERIFIED date, and a pointer back to this file. Verified: those two are now URL-string extractable; the other five (platte_mo, kent_mi, ottawa_mi, richmond_city_va, dallas_ia) were deliberately left in their split root+relative / prose form, which is correct and not a defect — do not 'fix' them. Original (WRONG) note follows for the record: THIS FILE IS NO LONGER A STRICT SUBSET OF ITS OWN STATED SOURCE — DO NOT REGENERATE BEFORE RECONCILING. registry_purpose above declares this a derived, narrower index of county-endpoints.md, says that file wins on conflict, and instructs regeneration from it. Following that instruction today would SILENTLY DROP 7 endpoints covering 6 counties, because they exist only here. Verified 2026-09-06 by walking counties[*].arcgis.service_url and counties[*].supplemental_arcgis.service_url (20 primary + 1 supplemental) against every URL in county-endpoints.md. The 7 absent from the .md: jackson_mo (jcgis.jacksongov.org ParcelViewer/ParcelsAscendRelate/FeatureServer/1), platte_mo (services2.arcgis.com Platte_City_MO_Property_view), kent_mi (gis.kentcountymi.gov OpenData/Parcel_Related_Layers/MapServer/0), ottawa_mi (gis.miottawa.org HostedServices/ParcelsPublic/FeatureServer/0), richmond_city_va (services1.arcgis.com Parcels/FeatureServer/0), dallas_ia (gis.dallascountyiowa.gov Public/Parcels/FeatureServer/0) — all six PRIMARY arcgis blocks, mostly the 'next 5 markets' expansion counties — plus baltimore_md's SUPPLEMENTAL block (bcgis.baltimorecountymd.gov Property/Property/MapServer/1, the county's own true-polygon owner-bearing layer, as distinct from the scrubbed state extract that IS in the .md). Back-port these 7 into county-endpoints.md first, then regenerate. METHOD WARNING for whoever checks this next: a bare URL regex over the whole file gives a wrong answer in BOTH directions — it sweeps up prose in registry_purpose/verification_method/notes, and a shallow field walk misses these entirely because service_url nests one level down inside the arcgis / supplemental_arcgis objects. Walk the structure, not the text.

verification_method: Live HTTPS GET to '<service_url>?f=json' performed 2026-07-19 (curl, no auth). VERIFIED = returned a valid ArcGIS layer/table descriptor (name/type/geometryType, no error envelope). VERIFIED-PARTIAL = layer is live but is geometry-only or attribute-thin per county-endpoints.md (still usable for a polygon pull). NOT-FOUND = no live public ArcGIS REST parcel/CAMA layer exists for this county as of this pass (documented data-hostile in county-endpoints.md); do not guess a URL. Re-run this verification pass at least quarterly — two endpoints already drifted between the 2026-06-05/09/11 source-doc runs and this 2026-07-19 check (see notes on dane_wi and kent_mi).

field_definitions.verified_date: Date of the live request that produced this entry's status
field_definitions.arcgis.service_url: Full REST URL of the specific layer (…/MapServer/{id} or …/FeatureServer/{id})
field_definitions.arcgis.layer_id: Integer layer/table id within the service
field_definitions.arcgis.layer_name: The 'name' field returned live by the service today — may differ from any name printed in county-endpoints.md if the county has since relabeled it
field_definitions.arcgis.type: 'Feature Layer' (has geometry) or 'Table' (attributes only, no geometry — not usable alone for a polygon pull)
field_definitions.jurscode: 4-character Maryland MdProperty/CAMA jurisdiction filter code (MD counties only — all MD counties below share ONE statewide service and are distinguished solely by this field)
field_definitions.notes: County-specific caveats relevant to a geometry/CAMA pull; full detail always in county-endpoints.md

franklin_oh.notes: Full-stack layer (owner, value, sale, BLDGAREA). PARCELID format '010-104049'. Best-in-class county per county-endpoints.md.

hamilton_oh.notes: Mirror also live at cagisonline.hamilton-co.org/arcgis/rest/services/Countywide_Layers/QueryLayers/MapServer/1 (not re-tested this pass). In-layer delinquency (DELQ_TAXES); no building SF anywhere in REST.

butler_oh.notes: PIN format 'A0700005000027'. VALUE20 null for all industrial — use bulk Owners CSV for value, this layer for geometry only.

clermont_oh.notes: Thin layer — no values/SF/sales in-layer (sales join at .../Sales/ParSales/MapServer/12). Fine for geometry-only pad/yard pull.

warren_oh.notes: Thinnest OH county — no values/SF/sales public. SDWLL_NBR 10-digit id.

anne_arundel_md.notes: STATEWIDE MD service — same service_url is shared by howard_md and baltimore_md below; filter on JURSCODE. NOTE: this is a POINT layer (parcel centroid), not polygon — sufficient for a FEMA point query but NOT for a true pad/yard polygon split (see ora-flood-zoning-dd Step 1 caveat). Owner names are SDAT-scrubbed statewide (mailing address only).

howard_md.notes: Same statewide service as anne_arundel_md; point geometry only. Owner names scrubbed.

supplemental_arcgis.note: County's OWN GIS — full TRUE POLYGON (not point) and publishes owner names (unlike the scrubbed state extract). Join state ACCTID to county TAXPIN on ACCTID[4:]. Full URL discovered/verified this pass (county-endpoints.md left it truncated as '.../Property/MapServer/1'). PREFER this layer over the statewide point layer for a Baltimore County polygon pad/yard split.

baltimore_md.notes: Statewide point layer verified for JURSCODE parity with the other two MD counties; supplemental county polygon+owner layer verified separately and is the better source for this county specifically.

jackson_mo.notes: Geometry is layer 1 (verified this pass — county-endpoints.md documents layer 2, 'Ascend_GisInfo', which is the CAMA ATTRIBUTE table, not geometry; both share parcel_number as key). Attribute-query quirk on layer 2 requires orderByFields=OBJECTID. PAGING QUIRK on THIS layer (1), added 2026-09-18: it can return 999 rows on a 1,000-row page while still setting exceededTransferLimit=true, so a loop that stops on a short page silently truncates (observed 2,999 of 4,666). Page on the exceededTransferLimit flag, not the row count, and advance the offset by the actual row count. See county-endpoints.md.

clay_mo.notes: Live current-parcel geometry layer confirmed, but per county-endpoints.md carries NO use code and NO values (those sit in a separate 2020-frozen snapshot service, parcels_2_view, not re-tested this pass — flag VALUES-2020 if used).

wyandotte_ks.notes: No tax-mail address published (situs only). Layer 1 of same service = 'Tax Sale Eligible' motivated-seller list.

johnson_ks.notes: Re-confirmed this pass: maps.jocogov.org/arcgis/rest/services is live but its FreeData2 layers are boundaries/utilities only — no parcel layer. AIMS open-data portal (jocogov-aims.opendata.arcgis.com) has no parcel layer; parcels are gated behind the paid AIMS Data Subscription (ADS). No live public ArcGIS parcel/CAMA endpoint exists for this county — do not guess one. Path forward unchanged: buy ADS extract or file a county appraiser records request.

platte_mo.notes: Geometry-only (TRC/SEC/BNUM/PNUM) — no owner/use/value fields, but usable as-is for a flood/zoning polygon pull, which is exactly what this registry is for. County GIS domains proper do not resolve; this is a municipal (Platte City) mirror covering the county.
